description: The sentences estimateExpiry returns. Every one says "expected expiry" and none says whether food is fit to eat. {name} is the lower-cased product name, {days} is "1 day" or "N days", {storage} is the lower-cased location and {printed} is the printed-date wording.
printed: The expected expiry is the date printed on the pack ({printed}).
learned: Your {name} usually lasts {days} in the {storage}, so that is the expected expiry.
category: No exact match, so the expected expiry uses the usual {days} for this kind of food in the {storage}.
fallback: Rough estimate: no matching information, so the expected expiry is {days} after adding.
